info.title: KINDLING Platform API
info.description: REST API for the KINDLING game client, game servers and web console. All errors use RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable `code`.

get.summary: Liveness probe: the process is running.
Readiness probe: PostgreSQL and Redis are reachable.

post.summary: Create an account with email + password. Sends a verification email and signs in.

refreshToken.description: Rotating; store securely (iOS Keychain). Single use.

post.summary: Sign in with Apple. New players must also send displayName (422 account.display_name_required otherwise).

nonce.description: Raw nonce; the app sends sha256(nonce) to Apple.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token. Reusing a refresh token ends the session.
Confirm an email address with the emailed token.
Request a password-reset email. Always returns 202 (does not reveal whether the email exists).
Set a new password with the emailed token. Signs out every session.

delete.summary: Request account deletion. The account is purged after a grace period and every session ends now.

post.summary: Cancel a pending account deletion (sign in again first).

put.summary: Write a cloud save slot. `baseVersion` is the version the client last read (0 for a new slot); 409 returns the current copy.
